geometry_levels.G0: legacy spatial join, first source-id catchment; complete source lines
geometry_levels.G1: clip/explode; preserve pieces; shared boundary assigned lowest numeric CaBA_ID

support_levels.S0: geology intersection only, historical accounting control
support_levels.S1: intersection plus explicit uncovered geometry, full network preserved

corine_levels.C0: historical first intersection, unmatched zero; diagnostic control only
corine_levels.C1: area composition; unknown area explicit; known-only point summary labelled conditional

geology_levels.U0: historical rules; unmapped drift .5 diagnostic only
geology_levels.U1: unmapped/unrecognised unknown, bounds0–1; omitted primary candidate

climate: raster masked mean × metadata scale + metadata offset; error stops; no valid pixels unknown
hydrology: WFD15m match coverage only; omit unsupported permanence from primary
weight_status: normative sensitivity settings, not calibrated ecological weights
pca: signed frozen transform for clean attribution; separately label refit and positive-share diagnostics
unknown_policy: lower/upper0–1 envelopes, no midpoint imputation; conditional known-only ranking explicitly not truth
rank_method: descending min; top5 stable sort score then CaBA_ID
phase2_not_run: 12-cell reach/catchment allocation, finer-vegetation comparison and independent evaluation require next gate
